text:
Simon-Cust: Hey team — customer on our private deploy (org: org-8142) is getting a 400 from the tooling router when calling the charge_invoice tool. Body they sent below and the API returns a schema validation error referencing additionalProperties 'promo_code'. Can someone confirm if there was a recent schema tighten?

maya: Thanks for the ping. Can you paste the full request (headers + body) and the exact SDK version they're using? Also confirm this is the private console (VPC) not hosted.

Simon-Cust: Repro payload (sanitized):
```json
{
  "tool_id": "billing-service-opaque-12",
  "customer_id": 12345,
  "line_items": "1x-enterprise-seat",
  "promo_code": "SPRING30",
  "metadata": null
}
```
Response: 400 
```json
{
  "error": "schema_validation_failed",
  "details": [
    {"path": ["promo_code"], "message": "additionalProperties \u2014 'promo_code' not allowed"},
    {"path": ["line_items"], "message": "type mismatch: expected array"}
  ]
}
```
SDK header: X-Client-SDK: redwood-js/1.2.1 (but customer says they updated to latest and still hit it). This is private (VPC) deploy.

maya: Ok, that lines up with what I suspected. We tightened billing tool's function schema yesterday to set additionalProperties: false and to require line_items as array of objects (to catch malformed invoices). That change was targeted at hosted, but looks like private control plane picked up the stricter variant via tool routing. I'm escalating.

jared: Confirming — we rolled a validator update in canary that enforces stricter fn-schema for billing-service to prevent silent billing regressions. On private deployments our router can sometimes pick the newer 'billing_v2' tool variant if tool_id matches the opaque id mapping. Could be a fallback selection bug where the router chose the strict variant for this customer.

jared: Can you give me X-Request-ID or correlation id from the failing call and the exact timestamp? Also include the full response headers if possible (we want the router.trace-id).

Simon-Cust: Request id: req_0a9f3c. Timestamp: 2026-03-17T14:22:10Z. Response headers attached (they pasted them). Repro curl below: 
```bash
curl -X POST "https://private-api.redwood.example/v1/invoke" \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  -d @payload.json
```
Where payload.json is the JSON above.

priya: Quick mitigation options:
- Client-side: change line_items to [ {"sku":"ent-seat","qty":1} ] and drop promo_code — that should unblock immediately.
- Server-side hotfixs: we can either (A) add a temporary tolerance shim in the billing tool that coerces strings to single-item arrays and allows promo_code as extra property; or (B) force router to pick legacy billing variant (billing_v1) for that org id until clients migrate.

maya: Customer prefers not to change their payload right away. They asked for a server-side tolerance fix. Is option B faster?

jared: Option B (routing override) is quickest: set mapping for org-8142 to billing_v1. I can push a routing rule that takes effect within ~15 mins. Longer term we need to revert the private deploy copy of the validator change or provide a compatibility shim.

priya: I'll prepare a small shim in the billing runtime to accept promo_code and coerce line_items strings to an array. That would be low-risk and could be hotpatched; estimate 2h including QA.

maya: Please confirm if this is an isolated customer or other private deploys might be affected. Any telemetry?

jared: Looking at router logs: 7 other private orgs hit same strict billing variant in last 24h but only this one sent promo_code + string line_items. We'll still push the routing override for org-8142 and schedule a coordinated rollback of the validator copy in the private control plane.

deploy-bot: Routing rule applied: org-8142 -> billing_v1 (tag: hotfix/2026-03-17/route-8142) :white_check_mark:

Simon-Cust: Confirmed customer can now invoke successfully after routing change. They still see occasional latency spikes (~500-700ms) on invoke but success 200s now.

maya: Awesome. I'll open a follow-up ticket to track the permanent fix (either relax schema for private deploys or ensure tool variant mapping doesn't auto-upgrade). Assigning to eng-runtime and senior platform PM.

jared: Notes for postmortem: source = validator copy drift to private, impact = single org hit by strict schema, cause = opaque tool_id mapping allowed variant fallback to billing_v2, mitigation = routing override + shim PR planned.

priya: I'll send the shim PR draft in ~90m and schedule a small canary in staging.

maya: Thanks all. Marking this thread resolved for support — moving to follow-up bug: INF-2347. :thumbsup:
